qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Competitive food/environmental testing and French clinical diagnostics fee cuts prevent full inflation pass-through, resulting in sub-hurdle 6-9% GAAP ROIC diluted by hundreds of roll-up acquisitions.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Broad bioanalytical testing network fails to generate hurdle returns, with multi-year GAAP ROIC mired at 6-9% due to heavy roll-up goodwill. Inability to pass through 2022-2023 wage/energy inflation and clinical tariff cuts prove insufficient pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Eurofins operates an extensive global network of over 900 laboratories across food, environmental, and clinical testing. However, reported GAAP ROIC has persistently averaged between 6.7% and 8.9% (below the 12% hurdle), diluted by endless small-scale M&A. When wage and energy inflation hit in 2022-2023, operating margin contracted to ~8.4%, showing lack of pricing power amidst regulated clinical reimbursement tariffs and fragmented competition.
